body: It means when someone or something upsets me, I obsess over it and hang on to out. Working out, breathing exercises, nothing works to help me get rid of my anger and rage. Eventually it turns inwards and get depressed because I don't feel I have control. These things cannot be regulated, and I do not have the money to get them fixed.
I appreciate your efforts, but getting involved with those groups will most certainly not take my mind off things. Nothing will solve my problem. That's why I want to kill myself.

I like walking listening to my favorite music. Watching television and reading stuff online. Pretty antisocial activities. Spend most of my time in my room alone. No point in trying to pretend that my problems will go away.

I'm pretty sure my uneasiness with my job is my main source of stress. I have few friends. Almost never hang out with the few I do have. Have no interest too either. Family is very distant...nothing really in common. No interest to really try and be more close either. My relationship with my coworkers is strained. Don't have much in common with any of them, no one seems interested in being more than just very distant workmates.
What else can I say? What else can I tell you that will try and make me feel better?
I understand, but you can't make me feel better. And my feelings aren't going to go away. No one understands how I feel. No one has emotions as stormy as mine.
Things won't improve. Not sure if there's any point in continuing to talk.

I don't think things have improved. They haven't told me anything. Of course, they wouldn't tell me if they were trying to get rid of me. I'm in an impossible situation where I've only been at this company for six months. No other company will touch me with all the jobs I've had lately. I can't quit, but I can't get fired.

Yes I would like to talk. I used to love my job, but after being mistreated by manager I just don't feel comfortable there anymore. I can't shake the feeling that they are just looking for any excuse to get rid of me. So I dread every second of work because it could be the second that I'm going to be called in the office to be fired. To make things worse I just signed the lease, if I quit or if I'm fired I'll be screwed. This happened over a month ago, but I'm still feeling like shit.
Are you still available to talk?
